description: Address 2 issues from semantic review: (1) Pass log_level to _setup_logging instead of calling get_settings() internally, (2) Fix HTML entity truncation in _format_answer by truncating raw text before escaping
steps: In main.py, change _setup_logging() to accept a log_level: str parameter and remove its internal get_settings() call. In main(), call settings = get_settings() first, then call _setup_logging(settings.log_level).
In handlers/inline.py, rewrite _format_answer to truncate raw answer before escaping to avoid splitting HTML entities mid-way.
acceptance_criteria: _setup_logging accepts a log_level parameter and does not call get_settings() internally
In main(), get_settings() is called before _setup_logging()
_format_answer truncates raw answer text before calling html.escape, avoiding split HTML entities
All modified files pass AST parsing
verification: Run: python -c "import ast; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in ['main.py','handlers/inline.py']]" to confirm syntax is valid
findings: Both fixes verified via AST parsing. Network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY so full import test not possible, but syntax is confirmed valid for all modified files.
